title: Russian — Yandex.Maps
authority: Yandex (Narodnaya Karta rules for transliteration of Russian names)
description: Practical scheme of the Yandex.Maps editing rules for Russian names: Е→YE word-initially and after vowels and Ь, ЪЕ→YE, Ё→YO, Щ→SCH, ending -ЫЙ→-IY, Ь→Y before И, otherwise Ъ and Ь omitted.
notes: Follows the current Yandex rules page: Е → YE after all vowels and after Ь, and Ь → Y before И. iuliia's JSON (2015 snapshot) has YE only after А И О У Э Ю Я and no Ь rules (Vasileva, Ilinskaya).

rules.note: word start, after vowels and Ь; ЪЕ → YE
Ь omitted except y before И

samples: Юлия, съешь ещё этих мягких французских булок из Йошкар-Олы, да выпей алтайского чаю
Yuliya, syesh yeschyo etikh myagkikh frantsuzskikh bulok iz Yoshkar-Oly, da vypey altayskogo chayu
Россия, город Йошкар-Ола, улица Яна Крастыня
Rossiya, gorod Yoshkar-Ola, ulitsa Yana Krastynya
